Package hadur.bench

Class Arms

java.lang.Object
hadur.bench.Arms
final class Arms extends Object
BENCH-92: the arms of a multi-arm run (--arms FILE). Each line of the file is label | robot name | jar, the robot name as Robocode lists it (hadur117.Hadur 3.14aa). Every (opponent, seed) job fights every arm, cold, on one worker home, in an order shuffled from the job (docs/plan-top5.md section 6.1), so a load or drift effect over a job falls on every arm alike instead of on whichever arm a fixed order puts first.

    • parse

      static List<Arms.Arm> parse(Path file, Path base) throws IOException
      The arms in file, relative jar paths resolved against base. Labels and robot names must be distinct (two jars under one name would install to one file, BENCH-2), labels must be safe in a directory name, and there must be at least two arms.

    • resumed

      static String resumed(Path dir, Arms.Arm arm, Opponent o, int seed)
      BENCH-95: the row a finished battle left in dir, when it was this arm's (same label and robot), this opponent's and this seed's, and it finished ok; otherwise null, and the battle is fought again. A failed or half-written battle never stands in for a fought one.
